docs.title: Documentation
docs.intro: {{brand}} is a modern, collaborative project management application designed to help teams organize, track, and deliver work efficiently. It brings together boards, columns, tasks, and sprints into a unified workspace that adapts to your team's workflow.
docs.workspacesDesc: Create isolated workspaces for different teams or clients, each containing multiple projects with their own boards and settings.
docs.boardManagementDesc: Organize tasks into customizable columns (e.g., To Do, In Progress, Done) with drag-and-drop support for easy prioritization.
docs.taskTrackingDesc: Create, assign, and track tasks with rich details including descriptions, labels, priorities, and due dates.
docs.sprintPlanningDesc: Plan iterations using sprints, assign tasks to specific sprints, and monitor progress with burndown-style views.
docs.teamCollaborationDesc: Invite team members via email, assign roles (Owner, Admin, Member), and collaborate in real time across shared workspaces.
docs.rbacDesc: Fine-grained permissions ensure that team members only access the resources appropriate for their role.
docs.techStackDesc: Task Board is built with a modern TypeScript-first stack. The frontend is powered by Angular with Spartan UI components and Tailwind CSS for styling. The backend runs on Cloudflare Workers with a MongoDB data layer. Shared type definitions and validation schemas ensure end-to-end type safety between client and server.

q1.question: What is Task Board?
q1.answer: Task Board is a collaborative project management application that helps teams organize work using boards, columns, tasks, and sprints. It supports multiple workspaces, role-based access control, and real-time collaboration.

q2.question: How do I create a project?
q2.answer: Navigate to your workspace, click the "Projects" section, and use the "Create Project" button. You will need to provide a project name and optional description. Projects are scoped to your current workspace.

q3.question: How do I invite team members?
q3.answer: Go to your workspace settings and open the "Members" tab. Click "Invite Member", enter their email address, and assign a role (Owner, Admin, or Member). They will receive an email invitation to join your workspace.

q4.question: What are subscription tiers?
q4.answer: Task Board offers Free, Pro, and Enterprise tiers. The Free tier includes basic board and task management. Pro adds advanced features like sprints and analytics. Enterprise includes priority support, SSO, and unlimited workspaces.

q5.question: How do I change my theme?
q5.answer: Click your avatar in the top-right corner to open the user menu. From there you can toggle between light and dark mode, and adjust the interface zoom level to your preference.
